name: Subset Teaching Dimension / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension Incomparability
details: For finite binary concept classes, neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For every $u\ge2$, the family $\mathcal C^u_{1/2}$ of all singleton and doubleton subsets of a $(u+1)$-point domain has $\mathrm{STD}=u$ and $\mathrm{NCTD}\le\mathrm{RTD}=2$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: Proposition 17(i) gives, for every $n$, a generalized paired family with $\mathrm{STD}=1$ and $\mathrm{NCTD}=n$.
proof: Theorem 36 of Zilles--Lange--Holte--Zinkevich gives the first family with $\mathrm{STD}=u$ and $\mathrm{RTD}=2$; no-clashing teaching dimension is at most recursive teaching dimension. Mansouri--Simon--Singla--Zilles, Proposition 17(i), constructs the reverse unbounded separation.
proof_source: Zilles et al., Theorem 36; Mansouri et al., Proposition 17(i)
